svg.title: The three lengths of a UDP datagram
svg.desc: A 60-byte frame carrying a 2-byte UDP payload: Ethernet pads the frame to its 60-byte minimum. The IPv4 Total length, 30, hands the transport layer exactly 10 bytes, padding excluded; the UDP Length field says 10, so it must equal those 10 bytes: the datagram is parsed and the payload is 2 bytes. A Length of 9 on the same bytes is a corrupt transport layer.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
